title: Il fait semblant d'être ruiné pour tester sa fiancée
style: 3D Pixar movie still, cinematic lighting, highly detailed

characters.FRAISE: a man with a human body and a giant red strawberry head with big cartoon eyes
characters.PECHE: a woman in pink dress with a giant peach head with big cartoon eyes and eyelashes
characters.CITRON: a chauffeur with a human body and a giant yellow lemon head with big cartoon eyes
characters.RAISIN: a waitress with a human body and a giant purple grape head with big cartoon eyes

scenes.image: FRAISE wearing a luxury black suit and gold watch, standing proudly on the balcony of a gigantic luxury mansion at night, sports cars and fountain below, city lights
lines: C'est l'un des hommes les plus riches du pays.

scenes.image: FRAISE wearing a black suit sitting behind a huge wooden desk in a luxurious mansion office, serious thoughtful face, CITRON standing next to him, warm lamp light, bookshelves
lines: Demain, j'épouse Pêche. Mais je dois savoir une chose.
Est-ce qu'elle m'aime moi... ou mon argent ?

scenes.image: close-up of CITRON looking very worried, sweating, in a luxurious mansion office, warm lamp light
lines: Dis-lui que j'ai tout perdu. Ce soir.

scenes.image: CITRON talking to PECHE sitting at a table in a luxurious golden restaurant with candles and champagne glass, night
lines: Madame... monsieur a fait faillite. Il ne lui reste plus rien.

scenes.image: close-up of PECHE shocked with wide eyes and open mouth, holding a champagne glass, luxurious golden restaurant background
lines: Plus rien ?! Même pas la villa ?

scenes.image: FRAISE wearing old torn dirty clothes, sad face, standing in front of PECHE who looks disgusted with arms crossed, on a dark street at night under heavy rain, street lamps, wet ground reflections
lines: Chérie, on peut recommencer à zéro. Ensemble.
Ne m'appelle plus jamais chérie. Je ne vais pas épouser un fauché.

scenes.image: a shiny diamond engagement ring lying on the wet ground in a puddle on a dark street at night in the rain, PECHE in pink dress walking away in the background, cinematic
lines: Elle a jeté la bague par terre... et elle est partie.

scenes.image: RAISIN kindly offering a cup of hot coffee to FRAISE who wears old torn clothes and is soaked by rain, at the door of a small cozy cafe at night, warm light from inside
lines: Monsieur, vous avez fait tomber ça. Et tenez, un café chaud. C'est offert.

scenes.image: FRAISE wearing old torn clothes sitting at a small table in a cozy modest cafe, emotional teary eyes, RAISIN smiling kindly next to him, warm light
lines: Pourquoi tu m'aides ? Je n'ai plus rien.
Pas besoin d'argent pour être gentil.

scenes.image: a long black luxury limousine parked in front of a small modest cafe in the morning, FRAISE in an elegant black suit stepping out of the limousine, people staring
lines: Le lendemain, une limousine s'est arrêtée devant le petit café.

scenes.image: PECHE in a luxurious bedroom staring at her smartphone with a shocked angry face, mouth wide open
lines: Quoi ?! Il n'a jamais été ruiné ?!

scenes.image: PECHE running with a big fake smile and open arms toward FRAISE who wears an elegant black suit with a cold serious face, in front of a small cafe, black limousine behind
lines: Mon amour ! Hier je plaisantais, tu sais que je t'aime !
Le mariage a bien lieu aujourd'hui...

scenes.image: FRAISE in an elegant black suit kneeling on one knee holding an open ring box with a diamond ring toward RAISIN who covers her mouth with her hands, surprised, inside a cozy cafe
lines: Monsieur... avant que je dise oui, vous devez savoir un secret.

scenes.image: close-up of RAISIN looking nervous and guilty, PECHE standing in the cafe doorway in the background with a furious glare, dramatic lighting
